blocks.prompt: 5 (a) A water tank develops a leak. Each week, the tank loses 5 gallons of water due to the leak. Initially, the tank is full and contains 2000 gallons [printed as 'container']. How many gallons are in the tank 20 weeks later?
blocks.explanation:
Har hafte tank se barabar miqdaar (5 gallons) nikalti hai, yani har qadam par ek hi number ghatta hai. Is liye har hafte baad pani ki miqdaar A.P. banati hai jis ka common difference \(-5\) hai.
Is hisse mein 20 hafton baad tank mein bacha hua pani poocha gaya hai.
Plan: \(a_n\) ka formula banayenge aur \(n = 20\) rakhenge.
steps:
Diya gaya hai: Bhara tank 2000 gallons; har hafte 5 gallons kam.
Humein find karna hai: 20 hafton baad bacha hua pani.
Tareeqa: \(n\) hafton baad miqdaar \(a_n = 2000 - 5n\) (A.P. jo 2000 se shuru hoti hai aur \(d = -5\)). \(n\) hafton mein 5 gallons \(n\) dafa ghatte hain, is liye \(5n\) minus.

\(n\) hafton baad ki miqdaar likhein
\[a_n = 2000 - 5n\]
Kyun: Shuru mein 2000. Ek hafte baad 1995, do hafte baad 1990: har hafte ek aur 5 ghatta hai. \(n\) hafton mein 5 ko \(n\) dafa ghataya, yani \(5n\). Yahan \(n\) hafton ki tadaad hai aur \(n = 0\) shuru ka waqt.

\(n = 20\) rakhein
\[a_{20} = 2000 - 5(20)\]
\[= 2000 - 100 = 1900\]
Kyun: 20 hafton mein \(5 \times 20 = 100\) gallons nikle, to \(2000 - 100 = 1900\) gallons bache.
Tasdeeq: nuqsaan sirf 100 gallons hai, is liye jawab 2000 ke qareeb hona chahiye; 1900 bilkul theek lagta hai.

blocks.prompt: 5 (b) A water tank develops a leak. Each week, the tank loses 5 gallons of water due to the leak. Initially, the tank is full and contains 2000 gallons [printed as 'container']. How many weeks until the tank is half-full?
blocks.explanation:
Har hafte tank se barabar miqdaar (5 gallons) nikalti hai, yani har qadam par ek hi number ghatta hai. Is liye har hafte baad pani ki miqdaar A.P. banati hai jis ka common difference \(-5\) hai.
"Half-full" ka matlab aadha bhara hua, yani 2000 ka aadha, 1000 gallons.
Plan: \(a_n = 1000\) rakh kar \(n\) nikalenge.
steps:
Diya gaya hai: Bhara tank 2000 gallons; har hafte 5 gallons kam.
Humein find karna hai: woh hafte \(n\) jab 1000 gallons bachein.
Tareeqa: \(n\) hafton baad miqdaar \(a_n = 2000 - 5n\) (A.P. jo 2000 se shuru hoti hai aur \(d = -5\)). \(n\) hafton mein 5 gallons \(n\) dafa ghatte hain, is liye \(5n\) minus.

\(n\) hafton baad ki miqdaar likhein
\[a_n = 2000 - 5n\]
Kyun: Shuru mein 2000. Ek hafte baad 1995, do hafte baad 1990: har hafte ek aur 5 ghatta hai. \(n\) hafton mein 5 ko \(n\) dafa ghataya, yani \(5n\). Yahan \(n\) hafton ki tadaad hai aur \(n = 0\) shuru ka waqt.

Miqdaar ko 1000 ke barabar rakhein
\[2000 - 5n = 1000\]
\[5n = 1000\]
\[n = 200\]
Kyun: \(5n\) ko ek taraf aur numbers ko doosri taraf le gaye: \(2000 - 1000 = 5n\). Phir 5 se divide kiya. Matlab 1000 gallons nikalne ke liye 200 hafte chahiye, kyunke har hafte sirf 5 nikalte hain.
Tasdeeq: \(a_{200} = 2000 - 1000 = 1000\), sahi.

blocks.prompt: 5 (c) A water tank develops a leak. Each week, the tank loses 5 gallons of water due to the leak. Initially, the tank is full and contains 2000 gallons [printed as 'container']. How many weeks until the tank is empty?
blocks.explanation:
Har hafte tank se barabar miqdaar (5 gallons) nikalti hai, yani har qadam par ek hi number ghatta hai. Is liye har hafte baad pani ki miqdaar A.P. banati hai jis ka common difference \(-5\) hai.
"Empty" ka matlab tank mein 0 gallons.
Plan: \(a_n = 0\) rakh kar \(n\) nikalenge.
steps:
Diya gaya hai: Bhara tank 2000 gallons; har hafte 5 gallons kam.
Humein find karna hai: woh hafte \(n\) jab tank khaali ho.
Tareeqa: \(n\) hafton baad miqdaar \(a_n = 2000 - 5n\) (A.P. jo 2000 se shuru hoti hai aur \(d = -5\)). \(n\) hafton mein 5 gallons \(n\) dafa ghatte hain, is liye \(5n\) minus.

\(n\) hafton baad ki miqdaar likhein
\[a_n = 2000 - 5n\]
Kyun: Shuru mein 2000. Ek hafte baad 1995, do hafte baad 1990: har hafte ek aur 5 ghatta hai. \(n\) hafton mein 5 ko \(n\) dafa ghataya, yani \(5n\). Yahan \(n\) hafton ki tadaad hai aur \(n = 0\) shuru ka waqt.

Miqdaar ko 0 ke barabar rakhein
\[2000 - 5n = 0\]
\[5n = 2000\]
\[n = 400\]
Kyun: Saare 2000 gallons 5 gallons fi hafta ke hisaab se nikalne hain, to \(2000 \div 5 = 400\) hafte.
Tasdeeq: aadha tank 200 hafton mein khaali hua (part b), to poora 400 hafton mein; dono jawab aapas mein milte hain.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab mein "container 2000 gallons" chhapa hai; sahi "contains 2000 gallons" hai. Answer key mein "(a) 900 litres" likha hai, lekin di gayi values se 20 hafton baad \(2000 - 5(20) = 1900\) gallons bachte hain, aur sawal mein unit gallons hai, litres nahi. Key ke (b) 200 hafte aur (c) 400 hafte sahi hain.
